mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.room_no AS roomNo, r.is_hourly AS isHourly, r.room_type_id AS roomTypeId, rt.type_name AS roomTypeName, COALESCE(rp.price, rt.price) AS todayPrice, COALESCE(req.cnt, 0) AS demandCount, g.name AS guestName, g.id_card AS guestIdCard, s.check_in_at AS checkInAt, s.expected_check_out_at AS expectedCheckOutAt, c.channel_name AS channelName, CASE WHEN CURDATE() = STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN r.status WHEN s.check_in_at IS NOT NULL AND s.check_in_at <= STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND (s.expected_check_out_at IS NULL OR s.expected_check_out_at > STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status FROM room r LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id LEFT JOIN room_price rp ON rp.room_type_id = r.room_type_id AND rp.price_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM room_req_log WHERE req_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY room_id ) req ON req.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN stay s ON s.room_id = r.id AND s.status = 1 LEFT JOIN stay_guest g ON g.stay_id = s.id AND g.is_main = 1 LEFT JOIN channel c ON c.id = s.channel_id WHERE r.active = 1
AND ( r.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR IFNULL(g.name, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR IFNULL(g.id_card, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') )
ORDER BY r.room_no
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_req_log (room_id, req_date, content) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{date}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, req_date AS reqDate, create_time AS createTime FROM room_req_log WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND req_date = #{date} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND active = 1
